headline: Apple reportedly tests CXMT memory chips as AI demand tightens global supply
summary: Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) is reportedly evaluating memory chips produced by China’s CXMT Corp for use across products including iPhones and MacBooks as surging artificial intelligence investment places increasing pressure on global memory supplies. According to The Wall Street Journal, Apple has also held preliminary discussions with CXMT about potentially sourcing memory components for devices sold within China, citing people familiar with the matter.

content.title: Apple reportedly tests CXMT memory chips as AI demand tightens global supply

headline: Socket Mobile Partners with 3Eye Technologies to Expand Industrial Mobility Solutions for Apple-Based Frontline Operations
summary: Socket Mobile (NASDAQ: SCKT), a leading provider of data capture and delivery solutions, today announced a strategic partnership with 3Eye Technologies, a value-added distributor specializing in mobility solutions for the modern frontline workforce. Through the partnership, 3Eye Technologies will distribute Socket Mobile's portfolio of barcode scanners, contactless readers, and mobile data capture solutions to its network of channel partners across North America.
